 Cool weekend weather, but a rainy start to the workweek 
 Cool weather sticks around this weekend, with increasing rain chances late Sunday into Monday before another warmup arrives next week. By Henry Blakes Published : Nov. 14, 2026 at 8:14 AM CST | Updated : 4 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BATON ROUGE, La. (WAFB) - Cool weather sticks around this weekend, with increasing rain chances late Sunday into Monday before another warmup arrives next week.
 SUNDAY PLANNER AND RAIN TIMELINE 
 A chilly morning followed by cool afternoon temperatures on Sunday. Clouds will increase throughout the day as rain returns to the area. You won’t need an umbrella during the day, but we could see a few showers by late afternoon and the evening.
 Increasing clouds on Sunday. A few afternoon and evening rain showers. (WAFB) Low pressure will move into the northern Gulf by Sunday evening, bringing rain to western Louisiana and eastern Texas.
 Low pressure moves into the Gulf and brings rain to the area late Sunday (WAFB) Showers are likely to move into southeast Louisiana and southwest Mississippi Sunday night and linger through early Monday morning.
 Light rain likely Sunday night and Monday (WAFB) EXPECTED RAINFALL 
 Expect light, occasional showers and minor rain accumulations. Rainfall amounts are likely to remain under half an inch in most areas.
 Rainfall mostly less than half an inch (WAFB) EXTENDED FORECAST 
 Isolated showers should gradually taper off on Monday, and dry weather returns early in the workweek. We’ll see a warming trend as highs climb to the upper 70s and morning lows in the 50s.
